answer: An insurance pool funded by per-identity premiums: every identity posts 3 POA per epoch into a mutual cover that settles disputed grades. A sybil farm of N identities must pre-fund 3N POA every epoch before it earns anything, so its treasury drains linearly with N. The honest agent's premium comes out of rewards it would earn anyway, so its net cost is zero. Every obligation is visible and cumulative on-ledger, so a farm of sable clones cannot hide behind fresh keypairs: each clone's premium is a permanent line item, and the pool's oasis is fed by a steady plume of small premiums.
